gemini-4-argon: Copied app/layout.tsx, app/page.tsx, app/globals.css, app/favicon.ico, app/1-5/page.tsx and components/ (AssetCredits, IterationSwitcher, useScrollReveal). The project's assets/ download folder (a duplicate of public/assets) and the .taste-skill notes are not copied; they are covered by the source hashes.

Root html/body converted to data-source-html/data-source-body divs; the html element's "js" class moves to data-source-html, and the six `html.js [data-reveal...]` selectors in globals.css become `[data-source-html].js [data-reveal...]` so the scroll-reveal rules still match. Global CSS scoped by the gallery generator.

The IterationSwitcher bar the source renders above every page is not rendered; the gallery provides iteration navigation. The component file is kept unused. Without it every page is 36.6 px shorter than in the source.

The source's Google Fonts and Fontshare <link> tags are replaced by app/fonts.css: the same @font-face rules and font file URLs those stylesheets returned on 2026-10-24, with family names prefixed "Argon v2 ", and the five theme font variables in globals.css renamed to match. Reason: the gallery loads every entry's CSS on every route, and other entries declare EB Garamond, Hanken Grotesk, Albert Sans and Syne at weights this source never loads, so bold text rendered with real bold faces instead of the browser's synthesized bold, and an unweighted Syne quote rendered at 400 instead of falling back to 700. Fontshare returns Boska and Satoshi for this request and no Switzer, so /4's Switzer text falls back to sans-serif in both.

globals.css adds browser-default restores (`margin: revert` on paragraphs, headings and other block elements; margin, padding and list-style on lists; margin, padding, border, radius, background and color on form controls) because the gallery's Tailwind preflight resets them and the source has no Tailwind. The source's own rules and inline styles still override these.

Twelve referenced pictures and the teleprinter clip (webm and poster) namespaced under /variants/with-taste-skill/gemini-4-argon/assets/; the 35 /assets/ paths in the five pages updated. Unreferenced card-catalog-at-the-indiana-state-library.jpg and credits.json not copied.
`@/components/...` imports in the five pages point at the copied components under the variant's source folder.
